propositions: Project overlay entries on built-in overlay IDs must support additive trigger_tokens (literal substring matches on diff lines) and applies_to glob patterns that union with committed triggers.

Helper function project_trigger_extensions() reads project overlay's raw code_review entries and returns trigger_tokens and applies_to lists per built-in overlay id, bypassing effective_routing's replace semantics.
glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays must union project-extension triggers with committed triggers, with repo_root threaded from overlay_union call site.
Trigger matching is literal substring (case-sensitive, not regex) against added/removed lines in unified diff, excluding file headers.
Malformed project entries (non-list trigger_tokens, non-string token, unknown overlay id) are silently ignored without raising exceptions.
Backward compatibility is maintained: with no project overlay present, both trigger functions produce identical results to current behavior.
